summary: Waste Connections, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing TSX approval for renewal of its normal course issuer bid (NCIB), allowing repurchase of up to 12,578,462 common shares (5% of 251,569,244 outstanding as of July 31, 2026) over 12 months. Daily TSX purchases capped at 95,113 shares (25% of average daily volume); block purchases allowed. This follows expiration of the 2025 NCIB on August 11, 2026. No price per share or premium stated. Repurchases via TSX, NYSE, NYSE Texas, or alternative Canadian systems. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and potential share price support.
